title: NISAR InSAR ground-movement pilot, Qassim
conclusion: Not detectable yet. Over the 120-day Jun-Oct 2026 chain the desert noise of 5 km averages is 3.0 mm after the quadratic deramp (5.1 mm without it), while Saq-belt subsidence of 5-12 mm/yr would move the ground only 1.2-2.8 mm along the line of sight in that window; the smallest rate the current record could detect is about 29 mm/yr (vertical, 2 sigma). With 12-day pairs chained, 12 mm/yr becomes detectable after about 2.0 years and 5 mm/yr after more than 6 years of continuous data. Processed as a redundant network with long pairs, 5 mm/yr needs about 1.0-1.1 years, 4 mm/yr about 1.0-1.2 years and 2 mm/yr about 1.2-1.9 years (a year is the shortest record that separates the annual cycle). The deramp hides bowls wider than ~20 km. Irrigated fields sum to a median -32 mm of apparent line-of-sight movement over the same chain (idle fields -3 mm): water in the soil, not ground motion, so short-pair chains cannot monitor subsidence under farms.

phase_to_los.formula: d_LOS_mm = -(wavelength / (4 pi)) * phase * 1000, positive = toward the satellite
phase_to_los.sign_basis: ISCE3 (the NISAR processor) Crossmul forms reference x conj(secondary) and flattens with exp(-i 4 pi dR / lambda), so positive unwrapped phase = range increase (away from the satellite). The product spec D-102272 Rev E does not state the sign. Empirical cross-check: the hydrostatic troposphere cube follows the NASA POWER surface-pressure change with slope +0.93 (r = 0.94, 14 pairs) for the 'positive = more delay at the secondary date' convention, and subtracting the troposphere cube lowers the desert variance more than adding it in 10 of 14 pairs.
phase_to_los.vertical_equivalent: LOS / up-component (assumes vertical motion; one ascending geometry cannot separate horizontal)

masks.gunw_mask: fill 255, water flag, invalid subswath digit or any anomaly bit 8-23 excluded; bit 24 reported
masks.irrigated: mapped fields or Sentinel-2 max NDVI > 0.25, dilated 2 px (160 m)
masks.desert: WorldCover [20, 30, 60] and >= 400 m from irrigated land

winter.rule: lowest median 1 km desert variance among ionosphere +/- troposphere +/- tides

summer.rule: lowest median 1 km desert variance among ionosphere +/- troposphere +/- tides

troposphere_sign_check.meaning: the troposphere cube is in the same phase convention as unwrappedPhase if subtracting wins

hydrostatic_pressure_sign_check.meaning: slope ~ +1: the cube is positive for more delay (range increase) at the secondary date

noise_summary_mm.flag_rule: deramped desert pixel sd > 6.8 mm or corrected (no deramp) 1 km sd > 6 mm (plausibility ranges of the v2 critique)

false_movement.definition: per field: median over core 80 m cells of deramped LOS minus the mean of desert pixels within 2 km; active/idle from Sentinel-2 in the same season window; negative = apparent motion away from the satellite

detectability.model: var(k) = a + k q (k = pairs chained); a telescopes (per-epoch), q random-walks (non-closing)
detectability.network_noise: white per-epoch noise with variance a + q (one of today's 12-day pairs per epoch, no accumulation; mid), from half (low) to double (high) that variance
detectability.seasonal_terms: annual sine and cosine co-estimated for records >= 1 yr; shorter records linear only (optimistic, dotted)

sources: Othman & Abotalib 2019, Environ Earth Sci 78 (ENVISAT SBAS, 5-12 mm/yr)
Othman et al. 2018, Surv Geophys (4-15 mm/yr)

noise_floor_map.alt: Map of the Qassim box: 12-day line-of-sight noise of 1 km averages over desert, median 2.2 mm; farms, green land and towns are greyed out.

detectability.alt: Smallest detectable subsidence rate against record length: the current record detects only about 29 mm/yr; 12-day chains reach 12 mm/yr after about 2.0 years, a long-pair network reaches 5 mm/yr after about 1.0 years to about 1.1 years.

false_movement.alt: Bar chart per 12-day pair: irrigated fields show a few millimetres of apparent movement relative to the desert, idle fields much less.

false_movement_cumulative.alt: Histogram of summed apparent movement over the Jun-Oct 2026 chain: irrigated fields median -32 mm, idle fields -3 mm.

chain_noise.alt: Spread of the summed desert line-of-sight values grows with each 12-day pair, to 3.0 mm for 5 km averages after 120 days.

method_notes: 14 GUNW pairs (12-day nearest-neighbour; one 24-day pair, 2026-07-23 to 08-16) in two disjoint segments: winter 2025-11-01 to 12-31 (BETA, X05010) and summer 2026-06-17 to 10-15 (PROVISIONAL, P05023). GUNW never bridges 2025-12-31 to 2026-06-17, so the segments are analysed separately and never chained together.

Phase corrected with the product's ionosphere screen (included in GUNW but not applied); troposphere (ECMWF HRES via RAiDER) and solid-earth-tide cubes interpolated at the DEM height and kept only where they lower the desert variance.

Masks: connected component 0 or fill, coherence < 0.35, GUNW mask invalid/water/anomaly, irrigated land (fields + NDVI > 0.25) buffered 160 m. Noise statistics use desert land cover at least 400 m from irrigated land.

All values are relative to a stable desert reference (target >= 25 km2, >= 5 km from irrigated land, coherence >= 0.5 in every pair; relaxed along a documented ladder when the target does not exist, see reference_patch).
LOS mm = -(lambda/4pi) x phase with lambda = c / centerFrequency = 0.24393 m (19.41 mm/rad); vertical-equivalent = LOS / 0.72.
The quadratic deramp removes wavelengths above about 20 km, so deramped numbers bound only local differential movement; broad regional aquifer bowls are invisible to it (see the no-deramp numbers).
Minimum detectable rate = 2 sigma of a GLS rate with the noise model var(k) = a + k q calibrated on the summer chain.
caveats: No subsidence is claimed. The pilot measures the noise floor and the irrigation phase bias only.

No field-level displacement map is published: on irrigated fields the 12-day phase carries a systematic soil-moisture and vegetation bias that does not close in sequential sums, so chained field values are false movement, not ground motion.

Sign convention taken from the ISCE3 processor (reference x conj(secondary)) and cross-checked with the hydrostatic troposphere cube against surface pressure; the NISAR product specification does not state it.
Winter (BETA) and summer (PROVISIONAL) granules come from different processor releases and are kept separate.
Only one (ascending) geometry: vertical-equivalent values assume no horizontal motion. Literature rates are treated as vertical.

The detectability curves assume continuous 12-day acquisitions from now on and a noise model calibrated on a single 120-day summer chain; seasonal moisture, residual ionosphere in long pairs and decorrelation in long pairs may raise the network curve.

The network curves treat per-epoch noise as white, so they keep falling as T^-1.5; real records meet systematic floors (residual long-wavelength ionosphere, long-pair phase bias, reference-frame and seasonal non-sinusoidal signals) of order 1 mm/yr, so values below ~1-2 mm/yr are optimistic.

Rain: NASA POWER gives 142 mm over the box in the 2025-12-07 -> 2025-12-19 pair (mostly 15-18 Dec 2025). Pairs with desert coherence < 0.3 (2025-12-07: 0.24, 22% of desert valid, 2025-12-19: 0.25, 30% of desert valid) are decorrelated by that rain, which also gives idle fields a moisture offset.

Ionosphere: the screen leaves long-wavelength residuals in the flagged pairs (2025-11-25: 10 mm at 1 km without deramp, 2026-09-21: 14 mm at 1 km without deramp, 2026-10-03: 12 mm at 1 km without deramp); the PROVISIONAL mask flags the screen as interpolated over 98% of the box (bit 24); the screen-uncertainty layer is not a usable error estimate (median 4420 mm in BETA, 26 mm in PROVISIONAL granules, against 2-5 mm observed residuals).

Troposphere: the cube lowers the 1 km desert noise in 2025-11-01, 2025-11-13, 2025-11-25, 2025-12-07, 2026-06-29, 2026-07-23, 2026-09-21, 2026-10-03 and raises it in the other 6 pairs; the choice is made per segment (used: winter iono_tropo_set; summer iono), and per-pair numbers for every variant are in pairs[].noise_mm.

The design reference (>= 25 km2, >= 5 km from irrigated land, coherence >= 0.5 in every pair) does not exist in this farm-dense box: only 45 km2 of desert lies >= 5 km away, with median mean coherence 0.39 (sand). Used: ladder rung 6 (distributed, 112 km2, >= 1000 m from irrigated land). Spreads, deramped residuals, chain spreads and field offsets do not depend on the reference.
DEM heights are orthometric (EGM2008) used as ellipsoidal for the cube interpolation; the error is small against the 500 m cube spacing.
